senses.gloss:
mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Equipped, stocked, furnished or provided with necessary means or implements.
2 Assisted, abetted, befriended.
E.
स with, उपकार an instrument or assistance.

m. (-वः)
The sun or moon in eclipse.
E.
स with, उपप्लव a portent, an eclipse.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Tasting, keeping a fast.
E.
स with, उपवास fasting.

m. (-कः)
A man of a degraded caste, the son of a Cāṇḍāla by a Pukkasī female, and only to be employed as a public executioner, &c.
E.
see श्वपाक, the sibilants being irregularly transposed, व changed to उ, and that to the usual Guṇa letter.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Restricted, limited, qualified, special.
E.
स with, उपाधि discrimination, कन् aff.

n. (-नं)
Stairs, steps or a staircase.
E.
स with, उप above, up, and अन a going.
